nativeAdaptations: AVRoutePickerView and the native LiveKit speaker preference replace desktop audio-device selectors.
Camera flipping uses the native camera capturer.
Voice reports currently send text; no report clip is recorded.
limits: Native SDK RoomMoved events are validated against an accessible voice channel on the same server. The older yapper-move data-packet fallback is not accepted: the selected SDK delegate does not expose original sender identity when no RemoteParticipant exists, so server-origin attribution cannot be proven.
Microphone, camera, screen sharing, audio routing, interruptions and E2EE media interoperability still require physical-device/live-account validation.
